// diagnostic

E0713

This deep check uses the effect `{effect_name}`

What

This deep check uses the effect `{effect_name}`

Why

A deep check runs only where `--deep-checks` keeps it, so it may not act on the world outside the program, even through a call.

Fix

Move the work that uses `{effect_name}` out of the `#On(.Deep)` body.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0713: tests/ui/deep_check_effect.stderr.
